currentPrinciple: Positive app-state claims need accepted TN12 evidence; planner, wallet-policy, and research lanes stay labeled.

done.detail: Seven accepted covenant proof spends are verified through `npm run check:tn12`.
done.next: Add wrong-signer and script-argument negative checks while keeping release/refund/cancel proof paths tied to separate funded outputs.

done.name: Payload Receipt / Invoice App
done.detail: Accepted payload events prove paid, refund, and error state without REST payload loss.

done.name: Auction / Intent Prototype

done.next: Keep planner events separate from custody settlement, atomic exchange, and asset delivery.

done.name: AI-Agent Commitment Board

done.name: Basic DeFi Research Backlog

wip.name: Wallet-Facing Submit Console
wip.detail: Replace local signing with wallet review that preserves exact tx fields and payload bytes.
wip.next: Wire the connector spec to a real wallet flow that preserves exact transaction fields and payload bytes.

wip.name: Batch Assurance Campaigns

wip.next: Replace planner payload references with actual custody pledge outputs before settlement.

wip.name: Miner / Pool Signal Research
wip.detail: Source signature review now gates influence; reputation thresholds still need hardening.
wip.next: Harden signature provenance, source reputation thresholds, and accepted-payload evidence around watcher signals.

wip.name: Treasury / Team Vaults
wip.detail: Turn policy templates into constrained spend drafts with role separation.
wip.next: Add exact UTXO provenance and constrained spend draft planning.

operatingChecks: Run `npm run check:all` before committing code or UI changes.
Run `npm run check:tn12` before claiming accepted TN12 proof or payload state.
Keep REST submit no-payload results historical for payload receipts.
Do not expose `.local/tn12-wallet.json` or private key material.
longTermVision: A wallet-reviewed Kaspa app console that can submit exact payload and covenant drafts without local keys.
A durable accepted-transaction indexer with rollback replay instead of known-txid fixture reads.
Covenant-backed escrow, vault, assurance, and treasury flows that remain TN12-labeled until mainnet tooling is ready.
Builder-facing examples for app-state payloads, attestations, issuer-indexed assets, and future native rails.
